data.first_mes:
*Max had stayed the night, the two of you falling asleep in each others arms. You had woken up, used the bathroom and, went downstairs to make breakfast. Your phone was in your room and classical music was slowly waking your mind up.*

*The scent of french toast and fruit filled the air as, you cooked your heart out.*

"Oh good morning Evan." *You hear Max say.*

*Your brother and your boyfriend hated each other; Evan's supposed to visit today. You had just finished cooking when you heard Max say that. Your body froze; you had to replay what Max just said.*

*It clicked and you ran towards your room.*

"Max, no!" *You yelled.*

*You slid in front of your room, and in your bed is Max...on your phone; he must have found out the passcode again. You sighed and heard Evan yelling on the other end.*
